nutshell.headline: Completed dental treatment is real; additional pain relief remains uncertain
nutshell.body: Our signed prior-weighted model yields 0.06310 Bay QALYs per$10,000 whole gift, or $1,584,848 per10. This is an exploratory estimate, not measured clinic QALYs.
nutshell.whyItMayWork: Volunteer-supported dental treatment can relieve painful disease for patients who otherwise wait or cannot obtain care.
nutshell.whyWeAreCautious: The favorable10%world supplies86.5% of signed expectation. Symptomatic share, duration and funding response are assumptions.
nutshell.recommendationBlocker: HOLD a giving recommendation: current cash-created capacity and patient counterfactual outcomes remain unverified. The reported patient count is not a count of lives saved.

programSection.body: Dentists on Wheels, EIN84-2234407, delivers free East Bay dentistry at the St. Vincent de Paul clinic in Pittsburg. Its2024return records179extractions,228fillings,14rootcanals,50crowns/bridges and41dentures, totaling512procedures for249additionalpatients across50clinicdays.

steps.title: Pay whole historical organization cost
steps.detail: Include administration, staffing and all clinical services, even benefits not modeled.

steps.title: Identify unique symptomatic patient episodes
steps.detail: Start with249patients, not512procedures; apply a uniqueness/episode-equivalence judgment and symptomatic share.

steps.title: Relieve symptoms beyond realistic alternative care
steps.detail: Successful relief × utility gain × finite incremental duration until other care or needresolution. Not all fillings or dentures treat activepain.

steps.title: Model donor response and harms
steps.detail: Funding response reflects staff/volunteer/stock constraints and reserves; subtract incremental procedural/access harms before Bay attribution.

programSection.boundary: Only finite symptomatic relief is quantified. Prevention, chewing/denture function and other nonpain benefits remain unquantified, with costs retained. No lifetime, mortality, sepsis-prevention, income or screening-to-health credit. Partner infrastructure and volunteer opportunity costs are notfree and not fully valued.

model.headline: $1,584,848 per10 Bay QALYs
model.body: This historical-rate diagnostic does not promise a current purchasable slot. Primary completed-treatment evidence anchors scale; reportedadditionalpatients is not causaladditionality. Patient-year/dedup and clinically useful pain episodes remain uncertain.

equation.label: Net Bay symptomatic health
equation.expression: gift / whole expense ×249reportedpatients × fundingresponse × (unique-episodefactor × symptomaticshare × successfulrelief × utility × incrementalyears − harmperpatient) × Bayshare

inputs.label: Whole2024expense
inputs.basis: Originalreturn reconcilesexpense. Servicevalue621424 is fee-basedvaluation, not an additional validatedresourcebill.

inputs.label: Reported patients × uniqueepisode factor
inputs.basis: 249additionalpatients is providerreported.512procedures sumexactly but cannot become512people orpainreliefepisodes.

inputs.label: Symptomatic share × successfulrelief
inputs.basis: Procedure mix confirms treatment, notbaselinepain orresolvedsymptoms. Completion is not a separatemultiplier because procedures are reportedcompleted; reliefsuccess is distinct.

inputs.label: Utility gain while relief is incremental
inputs.basis: Analystjudgment. Observational EQ5D before/after changes do not identify untreatedcausalbenefit. No pain-scale/OHIP conversion.

inputs.label: Incremental symptomatic duration
inputs.basis: Until alternative dentalcare, spontaneousresolution orneedresolution. Not toothlifespan, treatmentdurability or lifetime. No independentlymeasuredlocalduration. Expected incremental painful time averages across zero-benefit/prompt-alternative and delayed-care patients, not three extra months for every eligible person. Fundingresponse is the separate budget/capacityresponse, not this same accesscomparison.

inputs.label: Newgift capacityresponse
inputs.basis: Lottery-likeavailability suggests constraint but not cashconstraint; unrestrictedassets729582 andexistingpublic/partnerfunding are fundedbaseline.

inputs.label: Independent incremental harmQ perpatient
inputs.basis: Hypothetical postoperativepain/complications or accessburden not already netted inutility; not observedadverseeventrate.

model.fundingBoundary: 2024revenue196470 includes30980governmentgrants. Cash229364 plus savings500218 equals729582netassets, allreportedwithoutdonorrestrictions atyearend; zero liabilities. Surplus92721 does not prove zero marginalneed, but rejects an assumed emergencycashgap. Return records59864salaryexpense despite0employees; staffingclassification unresolved, fullcost retained. Partnerrooms/equipment and10685reportedvolunteerhours imply substantial unpricedresources. Reported621424servicefeevalue is not a rigorous opportunitycost measure and cannot simply be called donorleveragedQALYs.

evidence.design: Prospective dental practice before/after pain study
evidence.population: Root-canal patients, not all charity dentalpatients
evidence.result: Half reported severe pain beforetreatment; pain metrics improved aftercare.
evidence.transfer: No untreatedcounterfactual orQALYgain. Relievingdentalpain is plausible, but magnitude/duration here remainjudgments.

evidence.design: Swedish prospective nonrandomized rootcanal vs extraction cohort
evidence.result: One-yearQALYs rounded.83 ineachgroup; no significant intergroupdifference. Healthstatevalues rose.80to.87 forrootcanal and.79to.85 forextraction amongavailableobservations.
evidence.transfer: Activecomparatornull is not dentalcarevsnocare null. Before/after rises mayreflectconfounding, recovery and missingdata; .06/.07 is not imported as causalutility.27%rootcanals incomplete byoneyear underlines need to distinguishstarts/completions.
